name: Grace Kollie
bio: Grace has been farming cassava for over a decade and supplies local markets in Monrovia.

name: Emmanuel Sackor
bio: Emmanuel specializes in upland rice production and works with a cooperative of 25 farmers.

name: Fatima Johnson
bio: Fatima is a certified cocoa grower exporting to international fair-trade buyers.

name: Joseph Kamara
bio: Joseph manages a 5-hectare oil palm plantation and produces raw palm oil.

name: Martha Zubah
bio: Martha grows peppers, okra, and bitter ball in a solar-irrigated vegetable garden.

name: Samuel Doe
bio: Samuel taps rubber from a smallholder plantation and sells to local processing plants.

name: Comfort Nyemah
bio: Comfort supplies fresh pineapples to hotels and supermarkets in Monrovia.

name: Isaac Freeman
bio: Isaac produces gari and fufu flour from his cassava harvest for regional markets.

name: Hawa Karim
bio: Hawa processes groundnuts into paste and oil, sold in bulk to urban vendors.

name: Peter Gaye
bio: Peter runs a lowland rice farm with irrigation and produces 3 harvests per year.

name: Rebecca Kamara
bio: Rebecca grows plantain and bananas on a 2-hectare plot near Paynesville.

name: Thomas Weah
bio: Thomas manages a coconut grove and produces virgin coconut oil for export.

name: Alice Toe
bio: Alice grows yellow and white maize and supplies local animal feed producers.

name: Daniel Sekou
bio: Daniel has been instrumental in organizing a cassava farmers' cooperative.

name: Miatta Johnson
bio: Miatta focuses on organic vegetable production for the growing Monrovia market.

name: Philip Kromah
bio: Philip is a seed grower and supplies certified rice seed to other farmers.
